verbs.name: edit.grade_stack
verbs.description: LAYERED color grading — a NODE-STACK of grade layers applied IN ORDER on one clip (a serial grading workflow vs the single per-clip edit.grade). Each entry in `grades` is the SAME object edit.grade accepts (contrast/brightness/saturation/gamma/temperature_k/lut); a layer specifies only the knobs it changes (the rest default to identity). The renderer emits each layer's grade filter in sequence, so layer 2 grades layer 1's OUTPUT, etc. The stack is the AUTHORITY when present: it supersedes (clears) the clip's single edit.grade. Identity layers are dropped; an EMPTY or all-identity `grades` clears the clip's grade entirely (renders byte-identical to ungraded). A SINGLE non-identity layer renders BYTE-IDENTICAL to the equivalent edit.grade. Any.cube LUT on a layer must exist and end in.cube (we ship no LUT files). Media clips on video tracks only. Forces the SOFTWARE render path (per-layer ffmpeg eq).

clip.description: Clip id (a media clip on a video track)

grades.description: Grade layers applied IN ORDER (each the same shape as edit.grade). Empty / all-identity clears the grade.

temperature_k.description: White balance in Kelvin (~6500 neutral, lower = warmer); omit for none

lut.description: Path to a user.cube 3D LUT (applied last in this layer); must exist and end in.cube

include_inverse.description: Deprecated compatibility option. Accepted for v0.6 callers but new operations use recompute-by-replay and have no inverse payload to include.

verbs.result: {op} — committed-op ride-along; old/new grade stack is in op.effects[]

verbs.name: edit.grade_window
verbs.description: GEOMETRIC POWER WINDOW — a REGION-scoped color grade on a BASE-track video clip. Grades ONLY inside a SHAPE; outside the shape is untouched. shape/points/feather/invert define the REGION using the SAME geometry vocabulary as edit.add_mask: 'rect' (points = 2 opposite corners [[x0,y0],[x1,y1]]), 'ellipse' (points = [[cx,cy],[rx,ry]] centre + radii), or 'polygon'/freeform (points = the vertices, ≥3). All points are FRACTIONS of frame width/height (0..1). feather = soft-edge fraction of frame HEIGHT (0 = hard) so the grade BLENDS; invert scopes the grade OUTSIDE the shape (grade the surround). The grade knobs are the SAME object edit.grade accepts: contrast (1=unchanged), brightness (0=unchanged), saturation (1=unchanged, 0=greyscale), gamma (1=unchanged), temperature_k (white balance Kelvin), lut (a.cube path, applied last, must exist + end.cube). Windows STACK: each call APPENDS one window (warm a face in one, cool the background in another — composited in order, and AFTER the clip's whole-frame grade). remove_index atomically REMOVES one zero-based window and cannot be combined with append/clear fields; enabled:false CLEARS all windows. An IDENTITY grade is refused (a window that grades nothing). Render: resvg bakes a feathered shape alpha → split the clip, grade one copy, alphamerge+overlay it inside the region (CPU/SOFTWARE path). v1: BASE (first) video track only (an overlay-track clip is refused); HSL/luma QUALIFIERS (key by colour) are a documented follow-up. A core op (replay-safe).

shape.description: Window region shape (polygon covers freeform). Required unless enabled:false.

points.description: Normalized points (fractions of frame W/H). rect/ellipse = 2 points; polygon ≥ 3.

feather.description: Soft-edge feather as a fraction of frame height (0 = hard edge; default 0).

invert.description: Grade OUTSIDE the shape instead of inside (default false).

temperature_k.description: White balance in Kelvin (~6500 neutral, lower = warmer); omit for none

lut.description: Path to a user.cube 3D LUT (applied last in the window); must exist and end in.cube

enabled.description: false CLEARS all windows on the clip (default true).

remove_index.description: Atomically remove this zero-based window index. Pass only with clip and optional rationale.

include_inverse.description: Deprecated compatibility option. Accepted for v0.6 callers but new operations use recompute-by-replay and have no inverse payload to include.

verbs.result: {op} — committed-op ride-along; clip, new_grade_windows and old_grade_windows are flat fields in op.effects[]
